provinceTextScope: Bataan; subset selected by exact GBIF verbatimLocality text, not a validated administrative polygon
question: Does the Ilanin Bay-labeled subset of Bataan GBIF-linked iNaturalist records support a site-verified species assertion or any approved species image?

snapshot.retained: The broader 251-row candidate search snapshot; exact coordinates remain only in ignored local storage.

summarySnapshot.retained: Sanitized metadata summary with public observation IDs, GBIF keys, taxon labels, broad placeGuess, privacy state, positional-accuracy summaries, and photo-license counts; no coordinates, usernames, photo URLs, or image files.

crossPlatformTaxonConflict.disposition: Hold identity; do not merge name variants or project a species assertion until an authoritative taxonomic crosswalk and visual evidence resolve the record.

findings.positionalAccuracyMedianNote: Arithmetic median recomputed from the 16 retained positional-accuracy values is 44 m; the ignored source summary reports 46 m. Preserve this discrepancy rather than treating the summary statistic as independently confirmed.

interpretation.decision: The records share a broad public place label, but GBIF locality and waterBody fields are absent and verbatimLocality/placeGuess do not establish the capture station or a validated Ilanin Bay polygon. Research Grade and zero platform disagreements are not independent taxonomic verification. One Amphiprion record has conflicting platform labels. All 19 iNaturalist photo licenses are CC BY-NC; no media was viewed, checked against the existing Bangwit visual standard, or admitted. Keep the entire subset research-only.

limitations: The original 54 candidates came from GBIF stateProvince=Bataan text filtering, not provincial-polygon intersection; this 16-row subset is a further verbatimLocality string filter.
The exact GBIF locality and waterBody fields are absent for all 16 rows. Ilanin Bay is only the record text label; no boundary geometry or capture-site link was validated.
Reported positional accuracy ranges from 12 to 1,983 m; no coordinate values were retained in the review or sanitized summary.
All 16 observations are platform Research Grade and have zero listed identification disagreements, but those platform states do not establish a correct identification or wild occurrence.

GBIF maps occurrence 4054934942 from source name Amphiprion amamiensis to accepted name Amphiprion perideraion, while the current iNaturalist community taxon is Amphiprion annamensis; hold this identity conflict.

All 19 attached iNaturalist photos are marked CC BY-NC. Observation and photo licenses are separate; no image was downloaded, visually inspected, or approved for Bangwit. Do not use as an image reference without the species-image standard review, individual attribution, and a reuse decision that fits the app distribution.
These 16 records are observations, not a complete Ilanin Bay fish inventory; unreturned taxa do not imply absence.

The ignored source summary reports a 46 m positional-accuracy median; recomputing the conventional arithmetic median from all 16 stored values gives 44 m. Minimum and maximum agree; retain this small summary-statistic discrepancy.
nextStep: Continue Bataan candidate review with the remaining 38 iNaturalist observations and 66 NMNH/iBOL material-sample keys, prioritizing original site, capture-context, voucher and taxon evidence. Keep images gated by src/lib/species-images.ts and docs/SPECIES_IMAGE_STANDARD.md.

sources.supports: The GBIF occurrence source and accepted-name crosswalk for the one held Amphiprion record; its locality and waterBody fields are absent in the reviewed search snapshot.
Public metadata for the 16 linked observations, including Research Grade, current community taxa, geoprivacy/obscured flags, positional-accuracy values, and item photo-license codes.
Public observation page used to identify the iNaturalist side of the cross-platform Amphiprion name conflict; not independent taxon verification.
iNaturalist explanation that observation-data and photo licenses are separate and require image-level attention.

disposition.decision: Keep all 16 records research-only; no verified local species, waterbody occurrence, geometry, or image has been established.
